Collections technology

Foresight decides every next step, on every account, in every market

Foresight is the intelligence layer behind the platform. It scores each account on arrival and re-decides after every signal: which channel, what moment, which message, what offer. It's the same engine in every market, so a treatment strategy that works in one region is repeatable in the next, and every interaction across five billion insights retrains it. It gets better every day, everywhere at once.

Collections technology

Different books need different journeys. Same platform underneath.

Foresight applies a distinct treatment strategy to each portfolio type and reports it all back as one set of numbers, adaptable to whatever's in scope.

Consumer and BNPL
High volume and small balances mean cost per account decides whether an account is worth working at all. Digital-first engagement, self-serve plans and settlement offers keep the economics viable, with specialists reserved for accounts where a person genuinely changes the outcome.
SMB and commercial
A separate ruleset, queue and tone. Worked as a negotiation rather than a consumer journey, business and any personal guarantor pursued as connected tracks, with a defined pathway to your legal panel where warranted. Proven at 60.4% lifetime recovery on a comparable commercial book.

Data security and compliance

Independently certified, audited every year

Security and compliance verified by third-party auditors, with the controls to match in every market.

ISO/IEC 27001
SOC 2 Type II
PCI DSS v4.0
ISO 9001
ISO/IEC 42001
Data protection
AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit. SSO, MFA and role-based access. Documented retention and secure destruction at contract end.
Infrastructure
Cloud-native AWS, multi-region, with in-region data residency where required. 99.99% uptime. Segregated PCI environment. BCP and DR tested annually.
Detection and response
24/7 SIEM monitoring with IDS and IPS. Breach notification to you within 24 hours of confirmation.
AI governance
Every AI draft passes independent review. Protected characteristics never used in decisioning. Governed under the CTO, certified to ISO 42001.

Predictive payment optimisation
Learns each customer's cash-flow rhythm, payday cycles, past promises, dishonour history, and times every payment attempt for when funds are most likely there. Fewer failed debits, more cash collected.
Agent copilot
Briefs the agent before they pick up: full account context, the suggested next action and compliant phrasing, live. New agents perform like tenured ones from day one.
AI skip trace agent
Re-establishes contact with customers the file has lost, verifying fresh details across sources and reopening the conversation compliantly. Unreachable inventory becomes recoverable inventory.
